item.question: What are the key concepts involved in modifications of derived schemes?
item.answer: Modifications of derived schemes involve $U$-modifications and closed $U$-modifications, focusing on proper morphisms and closed immersions over a quasi-compact open subscheme. Derived blowups and locally of finite presentation (lafp) modifications play a crucial role.
